cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(candidate_json C)
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(JSON REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET json-c)
add_executable(json-consumer json.c)
target_link_libraries(json-consumer PRIVATE PkgConfig::JSON)
install(TARGETS json-consumer RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME installed-interface COMMAND json-consumer)
